title: Air Hockey Duel
description: True 3D air hockey on a neon table: real cannon-es puck physics, pointer-dragged mallet with full velocity transfer, three trajectory-predicting AI difficulties, best-of-7 matches, an 8-opponent tournament ladder and a cinematic replay of every winning goal.

achievements.title: Sonic Slap
achievements.desc: Score with a shot travelling over 20 km/h.

achievements.title: Off The Boards
achievements.desc: Score a goal that banked off a side wall.

achievements.title: Giant Slayer

achievements.title: Ladder Climber
achievements.desc: Defeat all 8 opponents on the tournament ladder.
